proposed_capability: Reuse an already cloned checkout and expose a self-contained, explicitly opted-in native listener lifecycle and five-second native responder gate.
player_save_control_impact: No change to desktop input permits. No new global hooks or raw input collection. New responder callback depends on a source-proven, exact-build native adapter that rechecks fresh game scope, availability, player input and queue ownership each time.
expected_outcome: Start the existing checkout without self-cloning. After an installed, opt-in native adapter registers, learn from attributed in-game choices and independent outcomes during player control; only consider a native action with independently rechecked five-second idle evidence.
negative_tests: File listed without native callback cannot count as running.
At 4.999s native effects yield, at 5s fresh recheck is required.
User input or scope change during analysis invalidates dispatch.
Existing checkout paths do not clone themselves.
Package imports support modules without a checkout.
rollback_path: Revert this branch or PR; existing legacy package, ordinary explicit host listener and established desktop gate remain available.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact-build EA lifecycle, player activity, queue and effect signatures and live registration remain local Windows evidence.
decision_rationale: The launcher and a packaged policy port are independently testable. Existing native package proof remains required. Reuse current learning math and fail closed on native readiness.
